title: Normality of Pi
exact_target: Does every finite string of decimal digits occur in the expansion of pi with its expected uniform limiting frequency?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1258 (NT-051). CC BY 4.0.
Jeffrey C. Lagarias, \emph{On the Normality of Arithmetical Constants}, arXiv:math/0101055v2 (2002), Introduction and Section 2, Definition 2.2.
